summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration that sets up two services: a Joomla web application and a MySQL database it depends on. The configuration defines which container images to use for each service, allowing them to run together as a coordinated application stack.

explanations.1: The 'services:' section tells Docker Compose which containers to create and run together.
explanations.2: This names the first service 'joomla' — it's just a label so you can refer to this container later.
explanations.6: This names the second service 'joomladb' (database) — the Joomla application will connect to this MySQL container using this name.
